name: @chuks/ffmpeg
description: FFmpeg for Chuks: a self-contained Rust cdylib shim over the ffmpeg-next crate (libav) for decoding, encoding, transcoding, filtering, and resampling media natively. Foundation for real-time streaming (@chuks/stream) and the @chuks/whisper live-caption audio tap.
author: Chuks Team
